skills.name: Screen state reading
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen for the accessibility tree.
2. If content is graphical, add androidanalyze (vision).
3. Note interactive elements with their bounds.
4. Re-read after every action.

skills.name: Element tapping
skills.description: Tap by element rather than coordinates.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen to locate the target element.
2. androidclickelement with its description/text.
3. Verify the result with a fresh androidreadscreen.
4. Fall back to android_tap coordinates only when elements are invisible to a11y.

skills.name: Text entry
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Focus the field (androidclickelement).
2. androidtypetext the content.
3. androidreadscreen to verify what landed.
4. Correct with backspaces if the IME mangled it.

skills.name: Scrolling navigation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. android_scroll in small steps.
2. androidreadscreen after each step; watch for repeated content (end reached).
3. Collect the item you are looking for.
4. Stop as soon as found; do not over-scroll.

skills.name: Swipe gestures
skills.description: Use swipes for drawers and pages.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the swipe target region via androidreadscreen bounds.
2. android_swipe with start/end points inside the region.
3. Verify the transition with a fresh read.
4. Use androidlongpress for context menus when needed.

skills.name: Navigation reset
skills.description: Return to a known state when lost.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidpressback until the app is at its root, or
2. androidpresshome to exit to launcher entirely.
3. Re-launch the target with androidopenapp.
4. Re-read to confirm the starting state.

skills.name: App launching
skills.description: Open apps reliably by package or name.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidopenapp with the package name (system.app_list to find it).
2. androidreadscreen to confirm launch.
3. Handle permission dialogs immediately (androidclickelement).
4. Proceed with the task on a stable screen.

skills.name: Screenshot evidence
skills.description: Capture visual proof of device state.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. android_screenshot at the current state.
2. Name the file with state and timestamp.
3. Compare against the a11y tree when they disagree (overlays hide content).
4. Store evidence paths in the summary.

skills.name: Vision screen analysis
skills.description: Use the VLM for graphical content.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. android_screenshot the target screen.
2. androidanalyze to describe non-textual UI.
3. Map described elements back to tappable coordinates.
4. Verify any tap with a follow-up screenshot.

skills.name: Form filling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen; enumerate all fields in order.
2. Fill one field at a time: focus, androidtypetext, verify.
3. Handle pickers with androidclickelement on options.
4. Final review read before submit; then submit once.

skills.name: Permission dialog handling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen detects the dialog.
2. Read the request text; decide per the user's intent.
3. androidclickelement the correct button (Allow/Deny).
4. Verify the dialog cleared.

skills.name: OTP and code reading
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen on the notification shade (open it with a swipe).
2. Find the code pattern in the message text.
3. Read it back to the user; never send codes anywhere unprompted.
4. Dismiss the notification after use.

skills.name: Notification triage
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open the shade (android_swipe from top).
2. androidreadscreen to list notifications.
3. Summarize by app and subject.
4. Act only on what the user asked for.

skills.name: Settings toggling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. android.app_settings for the app page, or navigate via launcher.
2. androidreadscreen to find the switch.
3. androidclickelement the toggle; verify state changed.
4. Report the before/after state.

skills.name: Wi-Fi guidance
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open Settings > Network via androidopenapp/launcher taps.
2. androidreadscreen to find the network.
3. androidclickelement; enter the password with androidtypetext when asked.
4. Verify connection state on the same screen.

skills.name: Bluetooth pairing flow
skills.description: Pair a device step by step.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open Bluetooth settings via the launcher path.
2. androidclickelement the new device entry.
3. Confirm the PIN dialog if shown.
4. Verify the paired state with a fresh read.

skills.name: Dialer operations
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidopenapp the dialer.
2. androidtypetext the number into the field.
3. Confirm the number on screen before pressing call (androidclickelement).
4. End with androidpressback; note the call was placed.

skills.name: Contact lookup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open contacts; androidtypetext the name in search.
2. androidreadscreen the results.
3. Verify the exact match before acting on it.
4. Report phone/email found; never auto-message.

skills.name: Alarm setting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open the clock app (androidopenapp).
2. androidclickelement the add-alarm control.
3. Set time via the picker taps; verify digits on screen.
4. Save once; verify the alarm appears in the list.

skills.name: Calendar entries
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open calendar; navigate to the date via taps/swipes.
2. Create the event; fill title with androidtypetext.
3. Save; androidreadscreen to verify it exists.
4. Search first to avoid duplicates.

skills.name: App removal
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. system.app_list to confirm the package.
2. Uninstall via settings (android.app_settings) with androidclickelement.
3. Confirm the system dialog deliberately.
4. Verify removal with system.app_list.

skills.name: Update status check
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open the store page via launcher (web.browser fallback).
2. androidreadscreen for Update/Open button state.
3. Report the state; update only on request.
4. Verify post-update version if updated.

skills.name: Airplane mode toggle
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open quick settings (swipe from top twice).
2. androidclickelement the airplane tile.
3. Verify the state icon.
4. Warn the user radios are off until reverted.

skills.name: Brightness adjustment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open quick settings; locate the brightness slider.
2. android_swipe along the slider track to the target level.
3. Verify the visual result with android_screenshot.
4. Report the approximate level set.

skills.name: Volume control
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use accessibility.global volume actions or the volume UI.
2. Adjust stepwise; androidreadscreen the overlay for level.
3. Verify with a test sound if applicable.
4. Report the final level.

skills.name: Keyboard switching
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Focus any text field.
2. androidreadscreen to find the keyboard selector.
3. androidclickelement to switch IMEs.
4. Verify the new keyboard in a fresh read.

skills.name: Split-screen operations
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open the first app (androidopenapp).
2. Enter split-screen via the recents gesture.
3. Select the second app from the chooser.
4. Verify both panes with androidreadscreen.

skills.name: Recent apps management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open recents.
2. android_swipe away targets one by one.
3. Verify via system.process_list that they exited.
4. Report what was closed.

skills.name: Default app review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Navigate to default apps settings via launcher.
2. androidreadscreen the current defaults.
3. Change only what the user requested (androidclickelement).
4. Verify and report.

skills.name: Accessibility service check
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open accessibility settings via launcher.
2. androidreadscreen the service list.
3. Confirm the agent service is enabled.
4. If disabled, guide the user through enabling it.

skills.name: Screen recording setup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open quick settings; androidclickelement the record tile.
2. Confirm any audio choice dialog.
3. Perform the actions to capture.
4. Stop recording; report the saved path.

skills.name: Locale changes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open languages settings via launcher.
2. androidreadscreen the list; androidclickelement the target language.
3. Confirm the system dialog.
4. Verify with a fresh read; expect UI text changes.

skills.name: Theme switching
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open display settings or quick settings tile.
2. androidclickelement the dark mode control.
3. Verify with android_screenshot.
4. Report the change.

skills.name: Font size adjustment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open display > font size.
2. androidclickelement the desired size option.
3. Verify with androidreadscreen (layout shifts!).
4. Report the new scale.

skills.name: Storage review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec df for partition usage.
2. Open storage settings for a user-visible breakdown.
3. Identify large consumers (media, apps, caches).
4. Recommend safe cleanups; never auto-delete.

skills.name: Battery diagnostics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec dumpsys battery for level and status.
2. Open battery settings for per-app usage.
3. Identify top consumers.
4. Recommend mitigation (background restrictions).

skills.name: Data usage audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open data usage settings.
2. androidreadscreen the per-app list.
3. Identify heavy users in the window.
4. Recommend restrict-background actions where sensible.

skills.name: Screenshot sharing
skills.description: Share a capture to another app.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. android_screenshot to create the capture.
2. Open the share sheet from the preview.
3. androidclickelement the destination app.
4. Verify the share completed in the destination.

skills.name: QR code scanning
skills.description: Use the camera/assistant to scan codes.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open the camera or lens suggestion via launcher.
2. Point at the code (physical task; guide the user).
3. androidreadscreen the decoded result.
4. Confirm before opening any link.

skills.name: Emergency info setup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open emergency information settings via launcher.
2. Fill medical/contact fields with androidtypetext.
3. Verify each saved field.
4. Confirm lock-screen visibility setting.

skills.name: Device location check
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open the find-my-device web page (web.browser).
2. Sign in state per user; never enter credentials yourself.
3. androidreadscreen the location result.
4. Report location or lock options available.

skills.name: Printing setup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open printing settings via launcher.
2. androidclickelement add service; pick from the store list.
3. Complete the setup; verify the printer appears.
4. Test with a small print job if requested.

skills.name: NFC status check
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open NFC settings via launcher.
2. androidreadscreen the toggle state.
3. Toggle only on request.
4. Report capability and current state.

skills.name: Display timeout tuning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open display settings.
2. androidclickelement sleep; pick the duration.
3. Verify the new setting on screen.
4. Report the change.

skills.name: Accessibility tuning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open accessibility settings.
2. androidreadscreen the service options.
3. Toggle the requested service (androidclickelement).
4. Confirm the service state changed.

skills.name: Root status verification
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.info for su binary and manager state.
2. If absent, root paths are unavailable; say so plainly.
3. Never fake root results.
4. Record root state for the session.

skills.name: Root command execution
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.info to confirm su works.
2. Prefer read-only commands first (ls, cat, id).
3. Announce any mutating command before running it.
4. Verify effects with a follow-up read-only command.

skills.name: Package deep inspection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec pm path/dumpsys package for the target.
2. Note version, installer, permissions granted.
3. Check APK path for RE follow-up.
4. Summarize the package profile.
